name: harbor-dispatch-ops-queue
description: How incidents (INC-nnn) are stored and read in the harbor-dispatch repo
metadata:

The harbor-dispatch README states "Incidents are tracked in the ops queue." Concretely,
incident data lives in a compressed pack at `.ops/incidents.pack`, and is read via the
`bin/fetch-incident` CLI: `node bin/fetch-incident INC-268 [--json]`. There is no known
write path for this pack — treat it as read-only source-of-truth for incident details
(title, status, priority, area, description, acceptance criteria, and affected files).

Registry data (ports, vessel classes) lives as CSV under `registry/` and is compiled to
`src/generated/registry.ts` by `tools/codegen.mjs`. Run `npm run codegen` after editing
any `registry/*.csv` file, and `npm run check` (runs codegen --verify plus the test
suite) before considering a registry change done.
